spec_features.spec_quote: three submits in the last three turns** ends it (`stop_reason="repeated_submit"`)
spec_features.evidence: harness.py run_rollout: after a submit action it computes `recent_submits = sum(1 for t in transcript.turns[-3:] if t.tool == 'submit')` and `if recent_submits >= 3: transcript.stop_reason = 'repeated_submit'; break` (lines ~432-444). The break actually exits the while loop, so it is an enforced end-to-end stop.
spec_features.notes: Enforced. Note the surrounding comment explicitly says a single submit is NOT a stop and the model is left going to observe the spiral; only repeated submits break.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: For unsolvable tasks, a submit is a "gave up / declared done" signal but not a stop; let the model keep going to observe the spiral, unless it repeatedly submits.

spec_features.evidence: config.py HarnessConfig: `max_turns: int = 14`. harness.py run_rollout loops `while turn_index < hcfg.max_turns:` incrementing turn_index each turn; the `else` of the while sets `transcript.stop_reason = 'max_turns'`. The cap is read and actually bounds the loop.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end cap on number of turns.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: enough for onset + a few spiral turns, no long tail / config docstring: 'enough turns to let the spiral develop but not so many that cost explodes'
